note: Public sample. The full suite is held out to avoid training-data contamination; its SHA-256 is given so results can be tied to the frozen version.
description: EE4 "form": 20 Estonian morphology and orthography items in four blocks (case and agreement, verb forms, numerals, spelling and punctuation), one control item per block. Deterministic one_of validator. Written from scratch, not taken from public datasets.
